outcome: 2-year motor function (difference between anatomic level of spinal lesion and functional motor level)
cohort: The study included 305 children with prenatal diagnosis of myelomeningocele from 14 North American Fetal Therapy Network (NAFTNet) centers, born between 2007 and 2020, who had a physical examination available at 2 years of life and did not undergo in utero repair.
finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with lower-extremity motor function at age 2 years in children with myelomeningocele.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with lower-extremity motor function at age 2 years in children with myelomeningocele.
